title: Compact support preserves lifted PBC lattices
statement: Let l be prime and E a finite extension of Q_l. For Noetherian schemes X and Y with finite topological dimension and l invertible in all stalks, let f:X→Y be quasi-compact and c=(j,p) a compactification. Use the actual lifted integral datum, completed coefficient rings and bounded constructible complete full categories of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Give those coefficient rings the canonical inverse-image identifications of [lem-cbc-integral-compact-support-uniform-restriction], and form the separate proper/open image of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For every lattice K on X, that image belongs to the same bounded constructible complete category on Y. No smoothness, base field, rationalization, scalar coherence, descent or summand assertion occurs in this lemma. The named coefficient system is the existing construction of [def-pur-rational-purity-coefficient-models].

proof.text: The proper map c.g makes c.Z Noetherian and finite-dimensional. Obtain the dimension bound by finiteType_source_dimension_bound. The global invertibility criterion turns stalkwise invertibility of l on X and Y into units in their global rings; pull the latter unit back to c.Z.

Apply integralCompletedLocalPerfectCriterion on X to the lattice K. Extend these stratified perfect models through c.i by cbc_extension_zero_stratified_perfect, using its canonical closed complement and the cover and disjointness identities. Apply the reverse local-perfect criterion on c.Z. This yields bounded constructible complete membership of J = cbcDerivedOpenShriek(delta,c.i)(K), for the existing lifted datum delta = pbcIntegralDatum l E. No transport to a different valuation-ring datum is needed.

The DVR maximal ideal is generated by the chosen uniformizer and contains l, since the extended spectral norm of l is its p-adic norm, strictly less than one. Map this ideal membership along ULift.ringEquiv.symm, which sends the generator to pbcUniformizer. Thus l vanishes in delta.ideal quotient. Bound every geometric fibre of c.g by the dimension of c.Z. Apply delta.constructible_preservation to the identity Cartesian square for c.g, with N=l and J from the preceding step, and take the direct-image conclusion.

Use coefficientIso_eq and openExtensionIso from IntegralCompactSupportUniformRestriction: the canonical finite-projection-normalized coefficient isomorphisms agree with delta.integralRingIso, and adjoint uniqueness identifies the displayed open extension with cbcDerivedOpenShriek. The direct image of that isomorphism identifies delta.push(c.g)(J) with the published pbcPurityCompactAmbient object. Transport membership along this isomorphism, using the lifted uniform complete category closed-under-isomorphisms instance.

lean.statement:
theorem pbcPurityCompact_lattices (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f)
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [dX : Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞))]
    [dY : Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞))]
    [iX : Fact (∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))]
    [iY : Fact (∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y))]
    (K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) :
    PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E)
      ((pbcPurityCompactAmbient l E c).obj K.obj)
